title: RTX Reports Q2 2026 Results (SEC-filed Exhibit 99)
publisher: RTX Corporation via U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
excerpt: RTX raised full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to USD 7.10-7.25 and free-cash-flow guidance to USD 8.50-8.75 billion after reporting USD 289 billion of backlog.
summary: The SEC-filed results exhibit provides RTX's Q2 operating results and raised 2026 adjusted sales, adjusted EPS, and free-cash-flow outlook for scenario valuation.
